coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 5 ground-truth variable items (60%): JaxMARL/SMAX with fixed hardware resources, MAPPO versus QMIX as primary algorithms, and wall-clock time to a defined performance threshold. Seconds rather than minutes are a convertible reporting difference.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses only three maps instead of nine selected by excluding maps with more than 10 units. Normalizes scores using (score − random)/(expert − random), rather than score divided by the scenario maximum. Additional ablations do not replace these missing requirements.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that PPO is expected to train 6× faster and outperform Q-Learning in most SMAX scenarios due to greater training stability and more effective policy optimization.
